summary: terminal_full.py validator/receipt publisher for plan acceptance-coordinator-trust-recovery; CLI requires --repository-root and --plan-dir with optional --out and --slice; computes sha256 bindings for contract, command registry, candidate source manifest, receipts; slice map R0-R5 selects pytest files and command ids, full run adds quick-dev-suite and acceptance-suite; candidate manifest only allows declared non-generated source paths and rejects root escapes/missing files; validates authority via plan-state status implementation-authorized or implementation-complete plus freeze/context hash match; maintainer authorization receipt required with plan id, transition, descriptor path/hash checks, v2 extra registry and skill-input-contract hashes; knowledge failures gate on non-catalog_stale codes and require source_refresh for catalog_stale; full run requires per-slice non-authorizing terminal receipts and valid resume-state; skill-input receipt discovered from resume pointer or newest matching json, validated against quick-dev-tdd-adapter contract; final full binding requires contract, registry, authority manifest, knowledge context, freeze, ready non-authorizing skill-input receipt targeting plan; registered commands are executed from command registry with repo-bounded cwd; result schema quick-dev-tdd-adapter.terminal-result.v1 has predicate slice-ready or implementation-complete, authorizes empty, lifecycle none; on full pass publishes repair/round-2 canonical quick-dev-implementation-complete v2 receipt and candidate-source-manifest, then mutates resume-state and plan-state to implementation-complete; failures are accumulated as stable codes and nonzero command ids; ambiguity/risk: output hash is computed before post-pass terminal_result_hash insertion, so canonical receipt binds pre-insertion encoded result
